itemized.notes: AMELIA POWERS GARDNER, County Clerk-Auditor, a CLOSE-OUT report with BOTH SCHEDULES HONESTLY EMPTY. modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20', born-digital typed fillable form, digitally signed ('Digitally signed by Amelia Powers Gardner, Date: 2022.04.01 12:23:29 -06'00''), printed and re-scanned.
